what: An 8px accent dot follows the cursor late by .25s (power3), and a blurred (2px) accent glow trail stays 250ms where the dot passed and then disappears (opacity (1−age/250)²). Trail thickness thins from 16px (slow) to 2px (fast, 2.8px/ms) with dot speed, glow spread 40px. Over links and buttons the dot grows to 16px and turns the text color (.25s). Mouse only — not drawn on touch

options.lag: Delay for the dot to follow (sec), default 0.25
options.vlo: Speed at which thickness starts to shrink (px/ms), default 0.08
options.--fx-trail-link: Dot color over link, default var(--kf-ink)
options.leave: Dot size (px) after leaving a link or button — the default returns to the original 8px. For the Name preset use 0.5 (the original writes .5rem as 0.5px, so the dot almost vanishes after leaving)

from.where: shared.js (original initDrawPathCursorEffect — dot quickTo .25 power3, dot history 250ms, thickness 16 − clamp((v−.08)/(2.8−.08))·14 followed at .5 weight each, opacity (1−age/250)², shadowBlur 40, canvas blur 2px, dot over links .5rem → 1rem). Dot after leaving 0.5px: leave: 0.5

note: The default cursor is not hidden (the original keeps it too). Nothing is applied for reduced motion or touch devices
